name: Chasidy Fisher Hobbs
title: Board Member
bio: Instructor in Earth and Environmental Sciences at the University of West Florida, where she also serves as director of Conservation and UWF Gardens and president of UFF-UWF. Her work connects natural-resource stewardship, public education, and institutional advocacy. Chasidy brings deep experience in environmental education, conservation, and campus-community leadership — all closely aligned with Bluffline's mission to expand access to trails, green space, active transportation, and resilient public landscapes.
